We randomly sample a small set with 60 hard full tasks and their corresponding 87 easy subtasks, and conduct a human evaluation for these samples to examine data quality. Our evaluation suite includes the following dimensions: 1) checking correct solutions for both hard full tasks and subtasks; 2) checking incorrect solutions for both hard full tasks and subtasks; 3) checking the quality and appropriateness of the subtasks.
